# pi-glance 0.6.7

## Changes

- Working activity now sweeps across the workspace title and connecting line, with a color chosen for each of the 22 palettes. Enabled by default.
- Add **General → Working animation** in `/glance`. Turn it off to use Pi's original Working indicator.
- Make the compact status line more consistent: fold Git upstream counts and automatic Model Provider/Thinking labels along with Context and Tokens details. Long model names shorten before disappearing.
- New installs use Nerd Font icons, smart workspace paths, one row above the editor, and all six status items enabled.

## Compatibility

- Tested with Pi 0.84.4 and 0.85.1 on Node.js 22.19.0 and 24.
- Existing settings are kept. Config files are updated only when you save.
- Bash-mode border colors and editor keybindings are unchanged.

## Update

```bash
pi install npm:pi-glance@0.6.7
```

Restart Pi or run `/reload`.
